rules: Do not use daily development branches as long-term on-device install targets.
A static tag only proves local static checks; it is not a road-tested stable version.
A stable tag requires a completed road-test log and a recorded previous stable or rollback base.
A stable tag also requires a checked C3 device snapshot with ESCC 0x2AB evidence.
Until current_stable_tag is set, daily_install_target must stay null.
